Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the historical sequence by proposing the Petronas Towers in Kuala Lumpur (1998) as the successor to One Raffles Place as the tallest building outside North America, conflating a later global milestone with the immediate successor. The correct immediate successor is the Bank of China Tower in Hong Kong (1989). This conceptual error would lead to the wrong city.
